text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Falling short against her rival, Mihono 
Bourbon misses out on victory in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing the emotion of "regret" for 
the first time... Unable to process it, 
she was left at a loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To banish this blazing frustration burning 
like fire, she seeks victory—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She moved on toward the Japan Cup, where 
her formidable rival Tokai Teio was 
expected to run.
